notes:
🚀 Lassi Lounge just got even better!

✨ What's New in this update:
- 🎁 Personalized Offers: Special targeted promo codes now appear directly in your Offers screen.
- 📜 Transparent Policies: Added a dedicated Terms & Refund Policy screen for better clarity at checkout.
- 🛍️ Cart & Checkout Upgrades: Added a clearer breakdown of fees with interactive info tooltips on both Cart and Checkout screens.
- 📱 Smarter Contact Validation: Your phone number is now intelligently validated based on your selected country code during checkout.
- 🔙 Smoother Navigation: Added a back button on the Cart screen and linked the Item Details directly to the cart for a seamless experience.
- 🎧 Quick Support: The Support button at checkout now directly connects you to our Help Center.
- 🐛 Minor bug fixes and performance improvements for a smoother ordering experience.
